title: AwardedBadge813's Beaconite Mod
description: Adds two tiers of Beaconite, which can be used for special beacons with higher tiers than traditional ones.
body:
Mixing Diamonds, Netherite Scrap and a Nether star has a curious effect...
Expands the Beacon system, Adding two tiers of beaconite for progressively greater effects.
adds 16 items, 23 blocks, and 5 effects to make nether stars and beacons more interesting.
Also adds a custom recipe type and a custom multiblock crafting sequence.
